method.design: full-cluster census (no sampling): all 291 2D3D items judged
method.groups: 24 bounded subagent groups (max 18 items; grouped by section, sections never merged)
method.judges: 24 independent general-purpose subagents reading destination notes and grepping the vault for surface forms + alternative terminology before any absent verdict
method.depth_standard: campaign plan section 5 (what it is / why it exists / how it works conceptually / relations to other concepts; project usage not required for 'covered')
method.evidence_rule: covered/equivalent/partial require a verbatim quote (>= 12 words for covered/equivalent) mechanically validated as a whitespace-normalized substring of the cited note (scripts/s33_validate_judgments.py, exit 0: 291/291 PASSED)

orchestrator_rereview.method: stratified even-spaced sample (every 10th record of the 291, 30 items = 10.3%): 20 absent verified by independent orchestrator greps of the agent search terms (all hits confirmed false positives: 'an 8-point improvement' in Process Reward Models is an accuracy delta not the epipolar algorithm; 'roof' hits are 'Proofread'/'proof' substrings); 10 partial/equivalent verified by reading the cited destination notes and judging the verdict + quote depth against the campaign depth standard
orchestrator_rereview.notes: The 30-item sample spans 2D3D sections and the partial/equivalent/absent verdicts (0 covered in sample). Notable confirmed judgment calls: Image Pair Mapping EQUIVALENT via the keypoint-matching treatment (Lowe's ratio test, RANSAC verification) in the Feature Descriptors note; Shared-Weight CNN EQUIVALENT via parameter sharing in Local Connectivity and Parameter Sharing; Curriculum Learning PARTIAL (project-note recipe, not a dedicated concept explanation); Coordinate Systems PARTIAL (2D image-vs-math origins explained, no world/camera 3D chain); Latent Slots PARTIAL via the Perceiver latent-array machinery (slot semantics absent); Computational Feasibility PARTIAL (worked FLOPs-to-wall-clock estimates never framed as a concept). All 20 sampled absent verdicts confirmed: pinhole/undistortion/eight-point/SuperPoint/surface normals/depth foundation models/monocular depth/ECA-Net/watertight/alpha compositing/CUDA rasterization/scene parsing/floorplan/DeepFloorplan have zero genuine vault occurrences.

limitations: single-judge-per-item design mitigated by mandatory multi-term search before absent verdicts + the 10.3% orchestrator re-review; borderline covered/partial calls carry uncertainty noted by judges
judgments reflect the vault as of session 32 state (no vault mutations occurred during judging)
'covered' does not include project usage; project context integration happens in the S37+ execution waves
